blockers.message: AC2 scope decision required from Human/Ops. Audit accepted: narrowing withdrawn, AC2 and overall_admission are blocked_pending_scope_decision, and the two foreign-cwd tests are relabelled in source as an unresolved gap. Formal proof in docs/deployment/evidence/twelve-loop-gap/OPS-L12-TELEMETRY-DISCOVERY-IMPORT-001/AC2_FEASIBILITY_PROOF.md (PR #4226, head 4628dc721): sys.path in the foreign-cwd no-PYTHONPATH environment is ['', stdlib, site-packages] with no repository entry; the repaired file never executes there because a nonexistent module name gives the byte-identical ModuleNotFoundError: services, so resolution stops at the services package and no edit to the repaired files can change the outcome; exactly four mechanisms can put the repo root on sys.path (PYTHONPATH, cwd, runtime sys.path mutation, site-packages entry) and AC2 forbids the first three. Constructive demonstration: one .pth line in a throwaway venv, exactly what pip install -e writes, makes dotted unittest 75 OK and direct file execution 35 and 40 OK from /tmp with no PYTHONPATH and zero change to the repaired files; removing it fails again. AC2 is therefore achievable by packaging only, which needs a root pyproject.toml the repository has never had plus a rule that every test environment installs it: a config change plus a process change, both outside this task and both excluded by the audit's own 'No config/process change' line. Decision requested: Option A authorize repository packaging and provisioning, preferably as its own build/CI-lane task, with AC2 standing verbatim; or Option B revise AC2 to the contract already proven and fenced by 15 tests (pytest passes from any cwd with no PYTHONPATH; repo-root unittest and discover pass with no PYTHONPATH; no process-global sys.path mutation; no failure ever attributable to a bare sibling) and track the packaging gap in the build/CI lane. Delivered repair is unaffected: 285 tests/0 errors/1 skip, 75 previously-unrun tests recovered, no production or config change.
